source_review.basis: Direct review of the benchmark PDF. The article is explicitly labelled Review and synthesizes prior literature rather than reporting a focal corrosion experiment for benchmark scoring.

evidence.snippet: Review — Electrochemical Characterization of Polymeric Coatings for Corrosion Protection: A Review of Advances and Perspectives.
This review summarizes the state of the art for the main electrochemical techniques...

contamination_examples: Historical resistance thresholds, salt-spray durations, EIS/OCP examples and coating performance numbers in the article summarize cited studies and must not become focal observations for this source.
